I did not edit this video. Claude and Codex did.

The assumption with technical content is that the animations are the expensive part. Someone sitting in a timeline, keyframing a diagram so an idea lands in four seconds. That is usually true, and it is why most engineers post talking heads instead of explanations.

What I do now is different. I describe what has to happen on screen, the models write it, and I review the output. Every decision about what the animation communicates is still mine. I am just not the one placing it frame by frame.

The part I find interesting is not the time saved. It is that the skill required changed. Editing used to need a craft I did not have. Now it needs the one I do: being precise about what I want, and catching it when the output is subtly wrong.

This clip is the example. Follow if you want the workflow.

Your S3 bucket is private and CloudFront still serves from it. That is Origin Access Control.

Here is the mechanism. CloudFront signs every request to your bucket with SigV4. The bucket policy is written to trust one thing and one thing only: that specific distribution. Anyone who finds the direct S3 URL gets access denied.

Why it matters beyond tidiness: if your bucket is reachable directly, every protection you put on the distribution stops being a boundary. Your WAF rules, your geo restrictions, your caching, all bypassed. And you are paying S3 request and transfer costs for traffic that never touched your CDN.

If you are still using Origin Access Identity, that is the legacy pattern. OAC replaced it and covers cases OAI never did. Switch.

Full walkthrough in this week's video. Link in bio.

.
.
.
#aws #s3 #cloudfront #cloudsecurity #devops

One VPS can hold ten projects. Most platforms charge you per project.

That is the whole decision and it flips at a certain number. With one or two side projects, a platform is genuinely cheaper once you count the hours you are not spending on patching, backups and uptime. Your time has a price even when nobody is invoicing you for it.

With ten projects, you are paying the same platform ten times over for what one box would carry. And the second question matters as much as the first: if clients are paying you to host their work, the reliability you are buying is no longer a personal preference, it is part of what you sold them.

So the honest answer is that there is no single answer. There is a threshold, and it moves depending on whether the projects earn.

Where would you put the line? Tell me in the comments.

🚨 WEB SOCKET OU HTTPS?

Se você é desenvolvedor web, provavelmente já utilizou os dois.

Mas você sabe realmente qual usar em cada situação?

A diferença parece simples:

👉 HTTPS trabalha muito bem com o modelo de requisição e resposta.

Cliente → Servidor → Resposta

Já o WebSocket mantém uma conexão aberta e permite uma comunicação contínua:

Cliente ↔ Servidor

E isso faz toda a diferença quando estamos falando de:

💬 Chats em tempo real
📊 Dashboards
🔔 Notificações
📍 Rastreamento
🎮 Jogos online
📈 Dados que precisam ser atualizados constantemente

Mas existe um ponto importante:

WebSocket não substitui HTTPS.

Cada um resolve um tipo de problema.

O verdadeiro conhecimento técnico não está apenas em saber usar uma tecnologia.

Está em entender:

🧠 Quando usar
⚙️ Por que usar
🚫 Quando não usar

Essa é uma das diferenças entre simplesmente escrever código e realmente entender como uma aplicação funciona.

💾 Salve este post para consultar quando surgir essa dúvida.

Você já utilizou WebSocket em algum projeto?

🚀 Backend é muito mais do que “fazer o servidor funcionar”.
 
Quando você clica em “Comprar”, faz login, envia um formulário ou recebe uma resposta instantânea de uma aplicação... Existe muita coisa acontecendo nos bastidores.
 
O Backend é responsável por:
 
🔹 Gerenciar dados com segurança
🔹 Executar regras e lógicas de negócio
🔹 Integrar APIs e serviços externos
🔹 Garantir segurança e escalabilidade
🔹 Manter sistemas estáveis e disponíveis
 
E é justamente essa parte que o usuário normalmente não vê.
 
Um bom Frontend pode impressionar visualmente.
Mas, sem um Backend bem estruturado, a experiência não se sustenta.
 
Por isso, desenvolver Backend não é apenas criar endpoints ou conectar uma aplicação ao banco de dados.
 
É pensar em arquitetura, segurança, performance, escalabilidade e confiabilidade.
 
💭 No final, o usuário não deveria precisar saber o que acontece no Backend. Ele simplesmente deveria perceber que tudo funciona.
 
E você, quando pensa em Backend, qual desses pontos considera mais importante?

As linguagens, frameworks e ferramentas evoluíram, e o que antes exigia horas de pesquisa, código e configuração hoje pode ser resolvido em muito menos tempo.

Ferramentas como ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini e Lovable conseguem gerar código, explicar problemas, criar interfaces, refatorar projetos e acelerar tarefas que antes consumiam boa parte do nosso dia.

Mas existe uma diferença importante: ter acesso a essas ferramentas não significa saber desenvolver.

Arquitetura, lógica, experiência, entendimento do negócio e capacidade de tomar boas decisões continuam sendo fundamentais.

A grande mudança talvez não seja programar menos.

É conseguir construir muito mais com o mesmo tempo.

Google's AI chips are now running in orbit 🛰️

Project Suncatcher just made contact. Google's first TPU satellite — launched Oct 1 aboard SpaceX Transporter-18 — is alive in low Earth orbit with four Tensor Processing Units on board, built with Planet Labs.

Why space? Solar in the right orbit can be ~8x more productive than on Earth, with near-continuous power. This test checks if TPUs survive radiation, heat, and vacuum — running AI in 15-minute bursts to manage thermals.

Not a data center yet. But it's the first real step toward orbital AI infrastructure, with two more test sats planned for 2027 for laser inter-satellite links.

Save this — space compute is no longer sci-fi.

Your AI forgets everything. Your brain doesn't. 🧠

Here's the flaw nobody talks about: teach today's AI a new skill and it literally wipes out what it learned before. Researchers call it "catastrophic forgetting" — and it's why every model update feels like starting over.

Your brain doesn't work that way. New memories stack on top of old ones without erasing them. Now, researchers at UT San Antonio have built a chip called Genesis that copies that trick: a neuromorphic chip wired like neurons, firing only when needed, learning continuously without forgetting — and sipping a fraction of the power.

A black hole jet is pointing straight at Earth — and it's inside our own galaxy. 😱

Swipe to learn what a microblazar is 👉

Some black holes fire twin jets of plasma at near light speed. When one aims at Earth, astronomers call it a blazar. For decades, scientists theorized smaller versions — microblazars — exist in the Milky Way. Now, after a strange deep-space flash, they've found one: IRAS 18293-0941.

The good news: it's far too distant to matter. The great news: it's a cosmic laboratory we can study up close.

latestIgtvVideos.caption: Everything in Porsche has evolved…yet has always remained timeless. There is no Porsche that is still carrying on today that’s older than the 911…except the crest it carries. The most timeless and important thing to any Porsche is the Crest…the first thing to see…and the last to be put on. I’ve waited a long time to button up a restoration like this…it will not be the last. Porsche of Dallas’s very own 993 is ready to be judged for the Porsche Classic Restoration Challenge 2022. 70% of all Porsches are still on the road today…and today one more air cooled 911 joins that percentage. More pictures will be posted when the owner see’s the car inside and out. #porscherestorationchallenge22 #porsche993 #aircooled911 #parkplaceporsche #porschedallas #parkplacetexas

As we wrap up our 993 for the Classic Restoration challenge…. we decided to give a tease. Can’t give away the interior just yet but I can definitely give away the the bread and butter to our updated sound system. New Classic Speakers are following with our Radio. This beautiful 993 came with a sound package, which happens to have its Nokia Amp still in tact and fully functional. #porscherestorationchallenge22 #993classic #porscheclassicradio #porschedallas #parkplacetexas #parkplaceporsche

“We all have a desire to create something that will show we were here. That we did something of value. To create something timeless.” - Ferry Porsche

latestPosts.caption:
I’ve been a certified Porsche technician for 10 years with very thorough technical knowledge and expertise in majority of the brands vehicles. (We just received some sweet add ons to the line up so it’s back to the books and waiting for cars to come in for service to become an expert on them). Before you ask….nope…I cannot share that technical info in depth. The benefit of being trusted with that information is not sharing it publicly. I love my job and I love Porsche enough to not go that far. 

#technician #porsche #mechanic #porscheexpert #yourporschespecialist #explore #cars #fyp #porsche911 #porschegrapevine #avondaledealerships #howto

As we come up on the last few hours for 2022…I wanted to do a little run down of this year for me and being at Park Place and with Porsche. I’ve got to meet many amazing people, worked and collaborated with my new friends, make new clients and new friends, restore an amazing car, win Regional champion twice in a row for the restoration challenge, drive repair a Guntherwerks and work with Guntherwerks on that repair, meet my favorite radio host to ever exist, meet a family idol, work with a few celebrities, drive my first set of Euro Spec Porsches including the 993 RS, 964 RS, 964 CLUBSPORT, and the 964 RS Touring, got to meet the GT4RS, I became a team leader and spread my knowledge, and even was given the chance to dabble a little outside of the brand and take a glance with Ferrari. I’m forever grateful for the year of 2022. It has meant the world to represent my favorite vehicle manufacturer to ever exist….to represent the crest with pride, to know I’ve made an impact in the classic world for Porsche. To all who follow me and know me in person, to the ones who entrust me with their beautiful machines, and to the ones whom I’ve inspired to restore a Porsche of their own….I thank you all. I do this for all of you. As our motto says….There. Is. No. Substitute. This accounts for the passion, for the cars and for the people and Porsche’s future. But…as our founder once said “we all have a desire to create something that shows we were here” I hope I’ve done my part in carrying Ferdinand Porsche’s legacy. Here are some of the coolest cars I’ve gotten to work on this year and the people who’ve I’ve idolized and got to meet…it’s definitely not including all of them. 70% of all Porsche’s are still on the road today…..I have done my duty in keeping that 70% for the year of 2022 and a Porsche Classic Technician. Look forward to seeing what Porsche has in store for 2023! #porsche #guntherwerks #porsche911 #rsr #gt3rs #gt4rs #993 #yourporschespecialist #endoftheyear #coolcars #pecatl #porschedallas #parkplacetexas #milesinthemorning #tomatowerks

Had a conversation about what’s the craziest car I’ve ever worked on…then I thought about all the cars that were “regular” cars for me. Hard to figure out what’s crazy when majority of the cars I’ve worked on are crazy. Hell…there’s like 5 dream cars of mine in these photos….just your daily reminder on how poor we are…

#explore #fyp #cars #mechanic #tech

Jobs part 4: Sub Boss. You ever had a car not turn off? Customer stated they couldn’t lock their car come to find out the car just flat out refused to turn off. The push start button was faulty…but as you can see it was “turning off” but immediately turning back on. Weird issue…funny…but weird. 

#explore #fyp #cars #technician #mechanic

Jobs part 3: Boss Level. What if I told you it was still running and drove in like that? Would you believe me? Because it definitely drove in like that. Don’t worry this was because of a tune. This was on a Cayenne GTS 4.0TT with a very aggressive tune, putting out more power than a Cayenne Turbo GT…this is not normal and I haven’t seen anything at this level on a stock unit. 

#explore #fyp #cars #mechanic #technician

Part 2 of jobs that made me question my sanity, the workshop manual, cry, laugh, and one made me take the rest of the day off to contemplate my next move. Can you tell me what the last slide is about? It’s a dying skill to understand and only applies to one car ever in the world. (Production car that is)

India found themselves in trouble early in the innings, losing four wickets for 87 runs. Kishan then took control of the situation, attacking the Sri Lankan bowlers and accelerating the scoring rate. He finished unbeaten on 80 from 46 deliveries, striking four fours and five sixes at a strike rate of 173.91. His contribution helped India reach 169/7 in their 20 overs.

Ci troviamo in un momento di grandi scoperte e di grandi incertezze. 

Il mondo dell'Intelligenza Artificiale da un po' di tempo sta sconvolgendo il nostro di mondo. 
Quello conosciuto, quello a cui eravamo abituati. 

Da una parte crediamo di sapere di più, conoscere di più e poter fare di più. 
E in molti casi è vero: abbiamo tra le mani un potenziale enorme. 

Dall'altra parte, però, stiamo rendendo più potente e sicuro un sistema che ci rende più insicuri. 

Non c'è scelta, non c'è decisione che ora non passi dal vaglio dell'I.A. 
La interroghiamo come fosse un oracolo, come fosse il nostro specchio delle brame, la nostra lampada magica. 
Le rivolgiamo domande, dubbi, desideri, le confidiamo aspirazioni, progetti, informazioni sulla nostra salute e sulla nostra anima. 

E mentre rendiamo più umana lei, noi ci trasformiamo sempre più in automi non pensanti.
Anchilosati, irrigiditi, piatti e senza colore. 
Dandole le sfumature stiamo perdendo le nostre. 
E rimane il Deserto...
Un Deserto abbellito di fiori finti, frasi artificiali, emozioni simulate, caroselli e attrazioni costruiti ad hoc senza dietro le quinte..
Preferisco il Deserto vero, perlomeno posso riempirlo come meglio credo. 

Claudya.

La vera sfida è riuscire a dare voce a tutte le parti di sé senza soffocarne alcuna. 
A prescindere da tutto e tutti.
E' molto facile esprimere e vivere una sola parte alla volta. 
E spesso sentiamo che sia giusto così, non sentiamo di stare facendo una rinuncia.
Abbiamo necessità di consumare e inglobare tutto ciò che quella parte ci può insegnare. 
Non sentiamo di fare alcuna rinuncia: quella parte che stiamo mettendo in atto, alla quale stiamo dando sfogo è talmente totalizzante da escludere tutto il resto. 
Può funzionare per un po', per giorni, mesi, anni, decenni, ma prima o poi le altre parti non espresse pretenderanno di emergere. Con più forza se ignorate troppo a lungo. 

Ecco perché, finché se ne ha la forza e la coscienza, è importante non trascurare nessun lato della nostra Anima, nessuna sfumatura della nostra Personalità e nessun Desiderio o Ambizione.

Claudya.

🌙Dicembre è un mese che arriva piano ma pesa più degli altri. 
Da una parte ti scalda, dall'altra ti mette davanti alle cose che hai evitato per mesi.
🌙E' il periodo in cui il mondo si illumina, mentre dentro le ombre trovano nuovi modi per farsi sentire.
Ci sono giornate che sanno di ritorni e altre che assomigliano a un vuoto che non sai spiegare.
Case che si riempiono di voci e altre in cui il silenzio risuona più del solito.
🌙Dicembre tira fuori le mancanze che non diciamo, le attese che non abbiamo avuto il coraggio di nominare, i ricordi che tornano senza chiedere il permesso.
Ti costringe a sentire ciò che hai, ciò che avresti voluto, ciò che non tornerà e ciò che invece ti sorprende ancora. 

🌙Eppure, col suo fare discreto, ti dà il tempo di capire cosa tenere e cosa lasciare andare. 
Non aggiusta le cose, ma ti permette di guardare senza scappare. 

🌙Caro Dicembre, sii gentile, sii buono, sii pieno di magia. 
Fa che i tuoi giorni ci ricordino che anche la FINE può diventare uno splendido INIZIO.

Every time I listen to it, I’m taken back to the person I was back then and reminded of who I’ve become today. To always stay strong, courageous and never change who you are just to fit someone else’s standards. 

I’ve learned that not everyone will listen and understand you, even the people closest to you and that’s okay. You don’t have to change yourself just to be accepted or fit into someone else’s idea of who you should be.

This album helped me through a time when I needed it the most and remind me to stay true to myself. 

A true masterpiece that will always have a special place in my heart. ❤️

The Bloomington-Normal Alumnae Chapter of Delta Sigma Theta Sorority, Inc. is kicking off the month with a few scams to keep on your radar:

💼 Employment Scams
💰 Recovery Scams
📱 Digital Arrest Scams
❤️ Romance Scams

Each week, we’ll highlight one topic and share simple tips to help you spot the red flags, protect your information, and stay cyber-safe. 🛡️

Follow along with BNAC throughout the month! 🔐❤️
#CybersecurityAwarenessMonth #BNACDeltas #StayCyberSafe #Tech #dst 

1️⃣ Employment Scams exist because of the large number of layoffs since the pandemic.

🚨How to stay safe:
📌 Never pay a fee to get a job.

📌Distrust big promises such as great pay and few hours for a work-from-home job.

📌Understand job-app risks of fake posts from reputable sites like LinkedIn and Indeed.

📌Scrutinize the source by checking the company website of the recruiter.

📌Be careful when posting your résumé because it is public.
 
Follow along with BNAC throughout the month! 🔐❤️
#CybersecurityAwarenessMonth #BNACDeltas #StayCyberSafe #Tech #dst 

2️⃣ Recovery Scams promises victims to recoup their losses by charging fees for their nonexistent services.

🚨How to stay safe:

📌Watch for upfront fees using gift cards or Cash App/Venmo.

📌Beware of phony checks and request of funds needed because to the criminal overpaid you.

📌Search the recovery firm’s name using keywords such as “scam,” “fraud” or “complaint”.
 
Follow along with BNAC throughout the month! 🔐❤️
